description: Create a Game UX: template chips, generateGame forwarding, preview with template and thumbnail visual, My games icons, fallback note; end-to-end tests with the mock model for each template and visual kind. Depends on FEAT-001 to FEAT-004.
steps: Add role=radiogroup #cgTemplates of .tpl-chip buttons (Surprise me default, then Monster Run, Picture Pick, Memory Match, Order It, Sort It, Bubble Pop; icon, name, 3-word blurb; roving tabindex and arrows) below #cgChips; cgTemplate local var reset to 'auto' on each open; disable chips in setCgBusy.

Module-block generateGame({prompt,grade,template}) forwards template; preview shows icon+name, title, 'subject Â· topic Â· N unit', #cgPreviewVisual with first visual at maxWidth 160; templateNote 'fallback' appends COPY.templateFallback; renderGameList rows start with template icon (missing or unknown type -> runner icon) and unit.

Update the client.test.js bridge and add e2e cases via trigger words for each template and each of the 8 visual kinds, template override, fallback, variety after 3 identical games, seeded v1 docs still list and play, malformed-visual seeded doc, logout/menu teardown.
Commit: feat(client): template chooser, preview and My games icons.
acceptance_criteria: Default chip is Surprise me and is sent as template 'auto'
Preview and My games show the template icon; v1 games show the runner icon
All e2e and client tests pass
